title: ButtonElementProps
description: The props of a button (epic Tale Studio R7): a call to action with a label, a style (filled or outline), colours and a corner radius, opening its destination in the same tab, or in a new tab without opener access. Clients render it as a link (`<a>`), named by its label. A draft may hold a button without a destination; publishing needs one (R7, R14).

label.description: The text on the button: plain text on one line, its accessible name.

href.description: The destination: an absolute http or https URL of at most 2,048 characters, without credentials, spaces or control characters (AD-15). Servers check it in full; clients check it again before rendering.

newTab.description: Opens the destination in a new tab, with `noopener`; the same tab when left out.

variant.description: `filled` paints the button in `fill`; `outline` draws only its edge in `fill`.

fill.description: The button colour as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA: its fill, or its edge for an outline button.

radius.description: The corner radius as a fraction of the canvas height; 0 when left out.
